intelligence.enrichment: A bean plant life cycle runs from seed to germination, appearance of leaves, flowers, fruits or pods with seeds, and death of the plant; the seeds in the pod can give rise to a new generation of bean plants. Growth produces the mature plant, flowers develop into fruit or pods with seeds, and those seeds continue the cycle before the parent plant dries and dies. The learner correctly applies this rule: A bean plant life cycle runs from seed to germination, appearance of leaves, flowers, fruits or pods with seeds, and death of the plant; the seeds in the pod can give rise to a new generation of bean plants. A plant life cycle ends when the plant has flowers.
